popCulture.title: Nauplius (mythology)
popCulture.description: Oeax (Oiax) is Nauplius' son and Palamedes' brother — the survivor who carries the news of the stoning and helps turn the father's grief into Capherian wreckage.

popCulture.title: Palamedes
popCulture.description: Oeax's brother — the inventor Odysseus frames; Oeax's false messages and Nauplius' beacons avenge the judicial murder at Troy.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus names Oeax among Nauplius' sons by Clymene — the Naupliad house that outlives Palamedes to punish the Achaean returns.

popCulture.title: Clytemnestra
popCulture.description: Later tradition has Oeax send false word of Agamemnon's death or betrayal to Clytemnestra — Nauplius' vengeance working through the Argive queen.
